title: Road Dust

items.label: Loose Road Edge
items.description: A passing vehicle lifts dust from a broken road shoulder beside pedestrians.
items.visual_focus: a wheel lifting dust from a broken road shoulder toward a pedestrian
items.local_cue: a battery-run easy bike wheel lifting grit from a damaged Rajshahi road shoulder

items.label: Dry Work Site
items.description: Wind blows loose sand from a roadside work pile toward nearby stalls.
items.visual_focus: wind blowing sand from an uncovered roadside pile toward a stall
items.local_cue: an uncovered sand pile beside a small Rajshahi roadside shop

items.label: Fast Passing
items.description: A driver speeds past a person who shields their face from dust.
items.visual_focus: a fast vehicle passing a person who shields their face from dust
items.local_cue: a maroon battery-run easy bike passing a pedestrian in roadside dust

items.label: Dry Sweeping
items.description: A worker sweeps dry dirt into the air beside a busy stall.
items.visual_focus: a broom lifting a thick cloud of fine dry dust
items.local_cue: a Bangladeshi street cleaner using a traditional long-handled straw broom

items.label: Uncovered Load
items.description: A small truck carries loose sand that spills along the road.
items.visual_focus: sand visibly spilling from an uncovered truck bed
items.local_cue: a small locally typical open-bed sand truck on a Rajshahi road

items.label: Small Cleanup Cart
items.description: A cleaner works around several fresh piles of road debris with one small cart.
items.visual_focus: one small collection cart beside several separate debris piles
items.local_cue: a municipal handcart and several separate construction-debris piles beside a Rajshahi street
